description: Na₉H₄S₄O₂₀Br crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/n space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one Br atom to form distorted NaBrO₅ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaBrO₅ octahedra and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-72°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.58 Å. The Na-Br bond length is 2.89 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.58 Å) and four longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O and one Br atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.54 Å. The Na-Br bond length is 3.33 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one Br atom to form distorted NaBrO₅ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaBrO₅ octahedra, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaBrO₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.53 Å. The Na-Br bond length is 2.98 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O and one Br atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.57 Å. The Na-Br bond length is 3.24 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaBrO₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-54°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.51 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaBrO₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-56°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.51 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one H, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one H, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. There are two inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight Na atoms. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight Na atoms.
